outputs.explanation: Panel A is a mass spectrum (line/scatter plot with labeled peaks) showing raw deconvoluted intensity data, not an averaged summary statistic requiring individual data points.
Panel B is a mass spectrum, same as A, showing raw spectral data rather than an average across replicates.

Panel C is a bar chart showing the proportion (%) of protein population bound to specific metal numbers, a value derived from aggregated peak intensities across a population, with no individual data points/replicates overlaid.
Panel D is a bar chart of PacL fraction (%) with no individual data points shown; only single bars per condition are plotted.
Panel E is a bar chart of PacL fraction (%) with no individual data points or replicate values overlaid on the bars.
Panel F is a bar chart of PacL fraction (%) with no individual data points shown.

Panel G shows per-residue chemical shift perturbation (CSP) values as bars for three specific metal equivalents (0.4, 1.0, 2), each bar representing a single measured value rather than an average of replicates, so no individual data points are required.
Panel H, like G, shows single per-residue CSP measurements at each metal equivalent rather than averaged replicate data, so individual data points are not applicable.
